Johns Hopkins affiliate running maternal, child and malaria programs, including seasonal malaria chemoprevention in Cameroon. GiveWell published one public model of its work; the most recent, from March 2025, puts it at **9.9× GiveDirectly (GW: 26× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.
